A16.change: Zoom allowed, main landmarks and skip links, persistent contact labels.

A17.change: Recovery requests returned 200; receipt verified in the agency Gmail mailbox. SPF, DKIM and DMARC all pass. Test messages landed in Spam. Branded subject/body configured; original template was still observed during the test. Recovery redirect is allowed.

A18.change: Service pages, canonical/social metadata, social PNG, favicon, sitemap, robots and stable campaign hashes. Anonymous campaign navigation works.

A19.change: Pinned production React/Supabase bundles; removed browser Babel and development runtime; build.sh uses npm build.

A20.change: Published /work/nfluence/ to demonstrate this website and creator workspace using verified first-party scope and features. No client endorsements or sales outcomes invented.

A21.change: Migrated apex and www DNS to Sites. Both certificates and custom domains are active. HTTPS www redirects to the apex while preserving path and query.

A22.change: User-approved public hosting cutover complete. Dependency-free Worker serves identical published assets with CSP including frame-ancestors, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, referrer and permissions headers. Verified on public domain.

A23.change: Enabled leaked-password protection on the existing Pro plan; configured recovery redirect; current security advisors report zero findings.

A24.change: Foreign-key coverage, scalar auth predicates and consolidated participant policies. Supabase reports zero performance warnings.

A25.change: Error boundary, visible failures, first-party events without inquiry content, generic backend logs, regression tests and CI checks. Server functions now prefer current Supabase secret keys; authenticated $299 quote and telemetry write verified against deployed endpoints.

A26.change: All twelve service CTAs have service-specific inquiry selection and accessible names.
